subject: Shortcut for plotting the result from table()

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: Shortcut for plotting the result from table()
parts:
Hi,

The numbers in data$x are all integer. I use the 2nd qplot to plot the
count per integer postion with 'line'. (Another way to is to use
histogram with binwidth=1, but I'd perfer lines). Although the 2nd
qplot() works, I'm wondering if there is any more concise way to do so
in ggplot2.

library(ggplot2)
data=data.frame(x=sample(1:100, 1000, replace=T))

p=qplot(x, data=data,geom='histogram')
ggsave(p, file='main.png')

tmp=table(data$x)
p=qplot(as.numeric(names(tmp)), as.vector(tmp), geom='line')
ggsave(p, file='main_line.png')

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.subject: Re: Shortcut for plotting the result from table()
parts:
Is this what you're looking for?

qplot(x = x,
y = ..count..,
stat = "bin",
geom = "line",
binwidth = 1,
data = data)
